tei:div.tei:p: "$ (251)༄༅// shangs pa'i gser chos khrid chen rnam lnga las/ me tog mkha' spyod dkar dmar gyi nyams len dbu ma'i mdud 'grol ces bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(252)༄༅// na mo gu ru badz+ra bā ra hī yai// rgyal ba ma lus 'byung ba'i chos kyi dbyings// bde chen 'od 'bar phyogs kyi na bza' 'chang*// zla ba nyin byed mdangs can der btud nas// zab mo'i rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung bzhin 'chad/ /mkhas grub kyi rgyal po khyung po rnal 'byor zhabs kyis ye shes kyi ḍā ki ni gu ma las mkha' spyod gnyis ka dang*/ grub thob nag po rā hu la las dmar mo/ dpal ldan a ti sha las dkar mo'i smin grol gdams skor rdzogs par gsan pas lugs srol de dag gi byin rlabs chu bo gcig 'dres su gyur ba'i nyams len gyi rtsa ba mkha' spyod dkar mo'i bskyed bzlas kyi rnal 'byor nyams su len par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems khyad par ba chos drug ltar tshig mtha' bsgyur ba'am/ yang na spyi mthun sangs rgyas chos tshogs lan gsum dang tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon tu 'gro bas/ oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhaḥsarbaḥswa bhā ba shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis 'khor lo bde mchog tu gsal pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar chos 'byung gru gsum dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba/ bde bar rgyu zhing bde bar 'char ba/ de'i dbus su hrīḥyig dkar po las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib (253)sbyangs/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog ston zla ltar dkar ba la yid tsam dmar ba'i mdangs kyis mdzes pa/ sgeg cing lang tsho la bab pa 'dzum khro chags pa'i nyams can mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur grol bas sku stod khyab pa/ dmar la bkra ba'i spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig hrig 'phrul bas gzigs pa/ thod skam lda'i dbu rgyan dang thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar stabs dang g.yon thod pa khrag gang phyir bstan tu 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis rgyab ngos nas phrag par bkal bas chu skyes ze'u 'bru lhag ger bzhad pa/

rked skabs phra zhing brla dang skye gnas nu 'bur mtho la bde ba rgyas pa'i sku phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ me ri dkar po rtse mo gsum pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa'o// rang gi snying kha nas sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyi mchod par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gi (254) bar gyis mchod // dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes mos gus shugs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ rje btsun ma'i gnas gsum gyi oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum spyan drangs yig 'bru gsum la thim/ 'bru gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gcig la gcig 'khril ba'i tshul du byon/ dbu ma'i lam brgyud bha ga nas thon/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ sdig sgrib nad gdon bar du gcod pa thams cad dag /rang gi lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo// de ltar na 'khor lo sdom pa dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma so sor snang yang thabs shes dbyer med ngo bo gcig tu gyur/ ting nge 'dzin de la yid rtse gcig tu gtad cing thams cad sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i ngang nas/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī yai badz+ra bar+kha nī yai badz+ra bai ro tsa nī yai hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes 'bum phrag sum bcu rtsa gnyis la sogs pa ci nus bzla'o// thun 'jog pa na gong bzhin mchod bstod byas/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dag pa mkha' spyod kyi gnas su 'khrid par mdzad du gsol/

zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab la 'og nas 'byung ba'i 'pho ba'i dmigs pa bsgom pa'am/ dkyus tsam la/ rje btsun ma 'od du zhu nas rang gi spyi bor thim pas lus kyi nang bdud rtsis bde chil gyis gang*/ sku gsung thugs rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs par gyur bar mos la 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag /de las ldang ba na dge ba byang chub du bsngo// thun mtshams rnams su snang ba lha sku sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam par lam du khyer/ zas skom ye shes kyi bdud (255) rtsir shes pas longs spyod/ 'dod yon thams cad lha sku bde ba chen por rang snang ngo*// skabs su gtor ma 'bul bar spro na 'og nas 'byung ba ltar ro// 'di la lus byin gyis brlab pa zhes bya ba rdzogs rim dang 'brel ba'i rjes gzhig zab mo ni/ rje btsun ma spyi bor bsgoms pa'i gsang gnas pad+ma nas byang chub kyi sems dmar po'i tshul du 'phros te byung*/ rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ lus gang bas 'od kyi rang bzhin dmar ltem ltem du song bas rgyud la bde ba khyad par can sing sing ba skyes/ de yang me long gi rlangs pa bzhin mtha' nas 'od du yal/ snying kha'i bar du bsdus/ mthar stong pa nyid kyi ngang la lhod de klod// rig pa dwang sing nger 'jog /slar bde mchog gam rje btsun ma'i skur ldangs/ yang gsang ba byin gyis brlabs pa zhes bya ba ni/ rang gi nor bu'i rtse mor mkha' spyod ma dkar mo gsal btab/ 'od du dmar ltem gyis zhu rdo rje'i lam brgyud lus kyi nang mer gyis gang*/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags sangs kyis dag /lus 'od kyi rang bzhin dmar ltem ltem du 'jug pa sogs gong bzhin bsgom/ 'dod chags la lhag par bsngags so// yang 'di la brten nas dam tshig nyams chags gso ba'i thabs ni/ mchod pa ci 'byor pa bsham/ byang chub tu sems skyed/ rang gi mdun tu pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma sku bkrag mdangs zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa 'od lam mer bzhugs par mos/

dngos bsham dang yid sprul gyi mchod pa rgya cher spel te ting nge 'dzin kho na'i stobs kyis sam tshigs bcad gang yang rung bas mchod/ dad gus drag tu bsgom la gsol ba drag por btab/ mdor bsdus spyi tsam du/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la phyi me tog bdug spos/ nang sha lda bdud rtsi lnga/ gsang ba bde stong gi ye shes/ yang gsang de kho na nyid gyi mchod pa dam pa rnams 'bul lo// bzhes nas bdag gi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang ba dang phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub stan thog 'di nyid du stsol bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ spyi (256) bshags bla ma rdor 'dzin ma lta bu'am/ khyad par rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la ma gus pa la sogs pa'i dam tshig nyams chags yid la dran pa de dang ming nas smos la bshags/ de nas bla ma'i smin mtshams su mkha' spyod ma dkar mo// de'i gsang gnas nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phog /sku mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul bas de dag gi smin mtshams nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dkar po byung*/ bla ma'i spyi bor zhugs pas sku la zag med kyi bde ba skyes/ slar mkha' spyod ma'i gsang ba nas 'od zer dkar nar gyis byung*/ rang gi smin mtshams su zhugs/ bla ma'i sku la dam tshig chags nyams su gyur pa la sogs pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sang gis dag par gyur/ oṃ gsum ma brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ mthar mkha' spyod ma rgyangs kyis byon nas rang gi smin phrag tu thim par mos/ des 'gres te/ bla ma'i mgrin par mkha' spyod ma dmar mo// 'od zer dmar po// gsung mnyes/ mgrin pa nas bdud rtsi dmar po// bla ma'i mgrin par zhugs/ 'od zer dmar po rang gi mgrin par/ gsung la dam tshig chags nyams/ oṃ gsum ma brgya rtsa/ mkha' spyod ma mgrin par thim/ de bzhin tu/ bla ma'i thugs kar mkha' spyod ma sngon mo dang 'od zer sngon po

oṃ gsum mam brgya rtsa/ mthar rang gi snying gar thim/ lha sku phyag rgya chen po'i dang du sing gis bzhag la yun ring du bskyang*/ mthar dge ba byang chub tu bsngo// bsnyen pa tshad ldan grub pa'i rnal 'byor pas mkha' spyod kyi ril bu bsgrub pa sogs rtsa ba'i gzhung las rtogs par bya'o// yan lag gi rnal 'byor myur la ma 'pho ba'i gdams pa ring brgyud thun mong ba ni yig rnying ltar la/ 'dir nye brgyud thun mongs ma yin pa ltar na/ gong gi bsgom bzlas gsol 'debs bcas grub mthag par ram/ 'di nyid sger du byed na skyabs sems sngon du 'phro bas/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'i lus gyi nang du rtsa dbu ma mda' smyug ltar drang (257) ba/ kha dog dkar po dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can/ mar sne gsang gnas dang yar sne tshangs bug tu zug pa'i spyi bor mkha' spyod dkar mo gzhon sha can yid du 'ong zhing bde ba chen po lhag par rgyas pa/ cha lugs spyi dang mtshungs pa zhig gi chu skyes dang dbu ma'i yar sne 'phrad pa shin tu gsal bar bltas la/ de nas rang gi smin mtshams yan gyi thod pa 'od du zhu phyag gi bhañdza dang 'dres/ rang lus lte ba yan gyi gdos bcas sha khrag rnams thod pa'i nang du zhu ste ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur pa gsol bas mnyes/ lte ba'i thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du rang gi rlung sems gcig 'dus kyi ngo bo a dkar po 'od 'bar ba yar la khang pa/ rdo rje'i rtse mor hūm̐ sngon po mgo gyen bstan zhig gsal gdab/ gsol ba drag tu gdab/ 'jam rlung cung zad bzung*/ yid kyis oṃ gsum ma bzla/ rgyu zhabs 'ubs kyis 'then la rlung phyir bsal ba'i tshe ti kra dang po brjod/ dmigs pa hūm̐ gi rlung shugs kyis lte ba'i a deng gis 'bul/ dbu ma'i nang nas skar mda' chad pa ltar rgyangs kyis song*/ rje btsun ma'i gsang ba nas zhugs/ thugs kar sleb/ rang sems dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang stong nyid gsum dbyer med du bsres la mnyam par 'jog

/yang a dang hūm̐ gsal gdab pa sogs dmigs pa de nyid lan bdun tsam bskyar/ de nas rang sems dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs dbyer med pa bdud rtsi dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa gsang ba'i sgo nas byon/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ 'khor lo bzhi gang*/ dbang bzhi thob// mthar lus thams cad byang sems kyis gang bas nyams bde bas khyab pa la mnyam par bzhag /de thun chung gcig yin/ slar rtsa dbu ma gsal 'debs pa nas bskyar te thun re la de 'dra tshar grangs gang 'gro bskyar te sbyang*// 'phro 'jog pa na rje btsun ma'ang 'od du zhu/ spyi bo nas rang la thim/ tshangs bug gser gyi rdo rje rgya gram haṃ yig dang bcas pas bkag par mos/ dmigs pa bsdu na gsol 'debs kyi rjes su hi ka zhes lte ba'i dbu ma nas a yig 'bar/ rje btsun ma'i gsang bar zhugs/ thugs kar sleb/ mkha' spyod du 'phur/ slar byon/ a (258)yig ka zhes slar lte ba'i dbu mar bab/ de ltar lan grangs bskyar/ mthar a bdud rtsi'i rnam par zhu/ rang lus sngar bzhin gsal ba'i spyi bo nas zhugs/ lte bar a brjid dang ldan pa'i ngo bor gyur/ tshangs bug bkag /mkha' spyod ma gshegs pa'ang lugs gcig ste/ de ltar rtags ma thon bar du sbyang*/ rang nyid 'chi khar las la sbyar ba'am/ shi ba'i 'pho ba gzhan la 'debs na rnam shes phyir mi 'bebs par rtags ma thon par bskyar nas sbar/ mthar rje btsun ma'ang mkha' dbyings je mthor gshegs par mos la spros bral gyi rang ngo bskyang bar bya'o// rje btsun ma 'di la yi dam ma chags par byas shing yar mar gyi tshes bcu'i mchod pa dang gsol 'debs la 'bungs na mkha' spyod du 'gro ba la the tshom med ces gsungs so// yang mkha' spyod ma dmar mo'i rnal 'byor nyams su len par spro na/ bskyed bzlas kyi rim pa la thog mar skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ /oṃ swa bhā ba sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid bde mchog lhan skyes 'od lnga 'phro bar gsal ba'i mdun tu chos 'byung gnyis brtsegs phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/

bde stong du 'char zhing rgyu ba'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma mi ro'i gdan/ de yi steng du baṃ yig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rnal 'byor ma li khri'i mdangs can/ dmar zhing bkra ba'i spyan gsum g.yo ba/ mche ba'i myu gu gtsigs cing khro gnyer yid tsam bsdus pa gtums pa'i nyams can/ gzhon nu ma lang tshol babs pa rked skabs phra zhing brla dang skye gnas nu 'bur mtho la rgyas pa/ gcer bu dbu skra sil bur grol bas sku stod khebs shing mdzes sdug yid du 'ong ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje mthur du bsnun cing g.yon thod khrag steng du bzung ba la zhal ras phyogs pas bde ba'i rgyun gsol ba/ gru mo g.yon par thabs kyi rang bzhin kha ṭ+wām̐ ga dkar po 'chang ba/ thod skam lda'i dbu rgyan dang thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ zhabs g.yas pa rgyangs pas mi ro'i snying gar brdzis shing g.yon phrag bar bgal (259) ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs par gyur/ spro na/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /sogs kyis bstod/ mchod bstod ma byas kyang chog /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ rang gi lte ba'i a thung gi 'od zer chos 'byung la phog /bag chags thams cad sbyangs/ rje btsun ma'i gsang ba'i chu skyes las 'od zer 'phros/ rang la phog pas sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs par gyur/ zhes mos la oṃ gsum ma bzla/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe mchod bstod gsol 'debs dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi rnal 'byor ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pa/ dge bsngo/ thun mtshams rnal 'byor sogs mkha' spyod dkar mo'i skabs bzhin bya/ 'di'i rdzogs rim thun mong ma yin pa ni/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i stong ra legs par gsal ba'i lte bar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa 'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba'i ze'u 'bru la mar me sor bzhi pa gsal gdab/

lus gnad rlung bum can sbyor ba bzhi ldan spyi mthun la lta stangs sna rtser dbab/ rlung gtong khar mid pa'i sbyor ba byed la gtum mo'i bde drod sbar/ de sgyu ma'i nyams dang bsres pas sgyu lus rang shar 'byung*/ de mgrin par bzhag pas rmi lam/ snying khar 'od gsal/ gsang gnas su bzhag nas thur sel dbang du byed/ dbang du gyur na las rgya dang ye rgya'i gtum mo bsgom/ de nas dkar mo'i skabs su bstan pa ltar rjes gzhig gi 'od gsal bsgoms pas bde stong zung 'jug mthar thug gi 'od gsal 'grub par gsungs te rā hu la dang a ti sha'i dgongs pa'o// 'di'i 'pho ba bsgom na/ mngal gyi rang bzhin chos 'byung sngon po'i nang du rang sems hūm̐ mthing kha las 'od zer 'phros/ mngal gyi sgrib pa dang skye gnas kyi bag chags sbyangs/ hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bde mchog dpa' bo gcig pa snang la rang bzhin med pa 'od zer lnga 'phro bar bsgom/ gong gi bskyed bzlas dang sprel na mchod bstod gsol 'debs grub pa dang mdun gyi rje btsun ma rang gi spyi bor byon par mos/ sger du byed na sems bskyed

(260) sngon tu 'gro bas rang bde mchog gi spyi bor rje btsun ma skad cig gis gsal/ sngar ltar rang gi dpung pa gnyis kyi steng du zhabs bzhag /gsang gnas pad+ma dmar po kha bye ba lta bu tshangs bug tu sprad/ rang gi lte bar rlung sems kyi ngo bo a dkar po 'phur la khad pa nang rlung gis yam yam bskyod bzhin pa des gyen tu bltas pas tshangs bug skya ha re ba de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang gnas mthong bas der 'gro ba'i 'dun pa drag po dang bcas gsol ba lan gsum btab pas/ thugs ka nas ba thag lta bu'i 'od zer dkar po nar gyis byung*/ lte ba'i a la reg pas khab len dang lcags 'phrad pa ltar thag gis 'then te tshangs bu ga nas thon/ bha gar zhugs/ thugs kar sleb pa dang tog sgra dang bcas rnal 'byor ma nam mkha' la yer gyis byon/ je mthor song nas mkha' spyod du pheb pa dang 'ja' ltar yal bar bsam la rig pa blo bral du 'jog /yang nam mkha' las sprin brdol ba ltar rnal 'byor ma lam gyis byon te sngar bzhin rang bde mchog tu gsal ba'i dpung pa gnyis la zhabs bzhag ste bzhugs pa'i thugs ka nas rang sems a yig chad de lte bar sleb pa des gyen tu lta ba sogs bskyar/ 'di'i skabs su 'jam rlung bzung ba gnad du che zhing spyi ltar hi kra ngag gam yid kyis bgrang yang chog go /thun mthar a lte bar phab ba'i rjes su rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'od du zhu/ rang gi spyi bo nas thim pa tsam mam/ de'i pad+ma nas byang sems dkar dmar bde khri li li babs/ rang lus 'khor lo bzhi gang*/ dbang bzhi thob/ zag pa med pa'i bde pas khyab/ rje btsun ma spyi bo nas lte bar byon/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes skyes par mos la mnyam par bzhag /mthar tshangs bug sra mkhregs rdo rje'i rang bzhin tu mos/ las sbyor ni dkar mo dang 'dra'o// mkha' spyod dkar dmar gnyis ka la thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul bar spro na/

bza' btung sna tshogs kyi gtor ma lag mthil g.yon par bzhag /g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis bzung la bsang sbyang*/ stong ba'i ngang las a dkar po las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ hūm̐ bh+rūṃ oṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ rnams (261)kyis mtshan pa'i sha lda dang bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang bar gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsir gyur/ oṃ ā:hūm̐/ lan gsum/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rje btsun mkha' spyod ma la 'khor ye shes kyi ḍā ki ma dpag tu med pas bskor nas byon par gyur/ pheṃ/ rje btsun ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs te gsol bas zag pa med pa'i bde bas dgyes par gyur/ oṃ gsum ma la 'bru gsum btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ ār+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs kyis bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs phrin bcol spyi ltar bya/ yig brgya dang bzod gsol byas nas/ rje btsun ma 'khor dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par gyur/ spro na phrin bcol gyi rjes su chos skyong spyi gtor yang bya/ gtor ma gtsang sar gshegs/ ༈ tshes bcu'i mchod pa sogs kyi sngon tu lag mchod spro na/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin brlab/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du pad+ma 'dab ma lnga par gsal/ nang mchod thig le dbus dang 'dab ma rnams la g.yon bskor du bkod de/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yaṃ/ hriṃ maṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ yig 'bru de rnams yongs su gyur ba las go cha'i dpa' mo drug gi skur gyur/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs dang*/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ lag pa'i 'byung ba lnga rigs lnga'i rang bzhin tu byin gyis brlabs/ lha rnams 'od du zhu nas lag par thim/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi ltar ram/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes pa tsam gyis yid kyis byin brlab/

lag pa g.yon pa'i mkhrigs mar chos 'byung sogs lha bskyed/ oṃ badz+ra yo gī nī ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha swā hā// badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs kyis phyi mchod dang*/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsol ba dang khyad (262)par du dag pa mkha' spyod kyi gnas su 'khrid par mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ yig brgya dang bzod gsol byas la/ dpral mtshams 'khyud rgya bcings te/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ lha 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par gyur// lugs 'di'i thun mongs ma yin pa'i chang mchod dam phyag mchod dam grib kun sel ni/ ka pā la mtshan ldan chang gis bkang*/ rang nyid skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ oṃ brjod bzhin tu srin lag g.yon pas dkar mo la chos 'byung rkyang pa/ dmar mo la nyis rim g.yon tu 'bri tshul bya/ thod pa chos 'byung gi gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i nang du chang thams cad sngags kyi yig 'brur dkar dkar mos dmar sgyur/ hram me gsal ba'i steng du hrī yig dkar po sogs dang*/ dmar mo la/ baṃ yig dmar pa ོ sogs bskyed chog mchod bstod kyi bar du bya/ oṃ gsum ma'i sngags 'bru rnams la do shal reg ge bzhugs par mos la reg tu btubs pa lta bur gsal gdab/ sku lus dang sngags 'bru las 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin byon/ khyad par bha ga nas rang byung byang sems pa de khri li babs pas thod pa khengs par bsam la bzlas pa ci nus bya/ mthar/ lha dang sngags bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin tu zhu nas thod pa khengs par gyur/ oṃ gsum ma so sor brjod la 'don bsgom dang mthun pa'i thigs gtor bya bzhin tu/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad mnyes nas sku gsung thugs zag pa med pa'i bde bas dgyes par gyur/

rang gi gnas gsum du rje btsun ma sku chung la yan lag dod pa dpag tu med pa sib sib thim pas nad gdon sdig sgrib grib dang mi gtsang ba la sogs pa sang sang dag par gyur/ gnas khang rje btsun mas mer gyis khengs nas sngags kyi rang sgra di ri ri sgrog par gyur/ rang nyid lha sku sgyu ma lta bur lhag par gsal bas rol pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi dam (263)tshig chags nyams dang las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad sangs kyis dag /bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes skyes par mos/ /de ltar nyams su blangs pas yi dam gyi zhal myur du mthong zhing lhan cig skyes pa'i rtogs pa skye bar 'gyur gsungs so// chad mchod de nyid tshogs gtor sogs la 'thor zhing rang la khrus kyang bya/ dam med kyis ma mthong bar gsang ba gal che/ gzhan gyi grib sel bya tshul ni 'gro mgon ston pa'i gsung las shes so// yar mar gyi tshes bcu'i mchod pa mdor bsdus pa ni/ stegs bu gtsang ma ba'i rnam lngas byugs pa'i steng du/ dkar mo la dkyil 'khor chos 'byung dkar po me ri dkar pos bskor ba'i dbus su thig le'am tshom bu dkar po gcig bkod/ de steng khi'ur me long la sum+bha ni brjod bzhin tu chang gis byugs shing sin+dhū ra brdal bar gser gyi smyu gu lag g.yon par thogs te snying po bzla bzhin pas rdo rje chos 'byung gi dbus su oṃ gsum ma phreng du bris te bkod/ dmar mo la gzhan ngo dang 'dra ba las dkyil 'khor chos 'byung dmar po gnyis brtsegs kyi mthar be bā dkar po nyis rim du bskor ba'i lte bar rdo rjes mtshan pa'i steng du me tog gi tshom bu lnga bkod/ me long chos 'byung gnyis brtsegs dbus suṃ baṃ la oṃ gsum mas bskor ba'i mtha' mar āḥyig bdun/ zur drug la go cha'i sngags/ logs drug tu dga' ba 'khyil ba drug bri/ steng du me tog gi tshom bu bdun bkod/

gnyis ka la dkyil 'khor ras bris byas nas rgyun tu 'chang bstabs bde la/ me long 'bri spyad gser smyug sogs kyang ma 'byor na der mos pa tsam gyis 'thus/ dkyil 'khor ras bris rdul tshon gang yang mi 'byor ba'i skabs su ni maṇ+ḍal la lag mchod chang gis mtshon byed bris te 'bru'i tshom bu bkod pas chog go /gang ltar de'i mdun tu kha zas bzang dgu las byas pa'i gtor ma/ chu gnyis nyer spyod sogs mchod pa gang 'byor g.yon bskor chos 'byung gi tshul du bkod/ g.yas su tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor/ g.yon tu chos skyong dang spyi gtor gnyis bsham/ (264) rang gi mdun tu nang mchod sngon gtor sogs mkho ba'i yo byad 'du byas la/ sngon gtor sum+bha nis bsang*/ swa bh+wa ba sa sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥs byin brlab/ pheṃ/ badz+ra ā ra l+li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbadz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ zhes mgron 'gugs/ oṃ kha kha khā hi sogs lan gsum/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la// gsang spyod don du gtor ma 'di// 'bul gyis yang dge bzhes nas kyang*// rnal 'byor bdag cag sogs phrin las bcol/ sum+bha nis bgegs bskrad/ gnas yo bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du/ bh+rūṃ las gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i mchod pa'i sprin phung zag med kyi bde ba skyed par byed pa yul dus chad pa med par nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas shab+da'i bar/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ya ā brta ya ho/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes byin brlab/ de nas rgyas par spro na rgyud sde lnga gtso bsdus sam/ bde mchog bdag bskyed bzlas pa bsdu ldang gi bar du bya/

bsdu na/ skad cig gis rang nyid dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pa'i skur gyur/ yig bdun brgya rtsa tsam bzla/ gong smos lag mchod dang chang mchod bya/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkha' chos 'byung sogs nas lha bskyed dang*/ dkar mo la gnas gsum byin rlabs bar/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ o rgyan gyi gnas dang mkha' spyod rdo rje'i grong khyer chen po nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bskor zhing*/ pheṃ/ chos sku spros bral dag pa las// longs sku sgyu ma'i tshul ston pa// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas rnal 'byor ma// phyag rgya chen (265)po'i dbyings nas bzhengs// sems can don la dgongs mdzod la// skad cig tsam gyis gshegs su gsol// oṃ badz+ra ā ra l+li hoḥ sogs/ rje btsun mkha' spyod ma la ye shes kyi ḍā ki sde lnga sogs rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma'i 'khor bye ba rdul snyed kyis bskor ba/ steng na rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ bar na yi dam gyi lha tshogs/ 'og tu myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po sogs chos skyong dam can rgya mtshos bskor ba spyan drangs/ mdun bskyed dang gnyis su med par bzhugs par gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gong ltar mchod bstod gsol ba gdab/ dmigs gnad bcas bzlas pa cung zad bya/ slar mchod pa kha bsos la byin brlab/ dwangs shing dri med yid 'ong ba'i// sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// oṃ shrī badz+ra yo gi nī sa pā ri bā ra ar+ghaṃ pra trīts+tsha hūm̐ swā huṃ/ de bzhin tu yon chab dang ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ zhabs bsil dang ma sbyar/ me tog bdug spos snang gsal dang*// dri chab zhal zas rol mo rnams// bdag gis dad pas khyed la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/

sngags gong ltar la/ badz+ra :puṣ+pe nas shab+da āḥhūm̐/ spro na/ yang dag dga' ba'i me tog sogs tshang bar brjod/ srab 'jam yang ba sogs kyis gos zung 'bul/ rang gi snying ga nas a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ aḥrnams spros pa las mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ oṃ bī ṇi badz+ri ṇī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin tu/ baṃ she/ mṛ daṃ ge/ mu ra dze/ hā s+ya/ lā s+ya/ gī tī/ nṛ tī/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ rū pa/ ra sa/ spar+she/ dharma dhā tu badz+ri ṇī/ zhes sbyar bas rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ phyogs dus kun na gzugs sgra dri dang ro// reg bya khyad par 'phags pa ci mchis pa// mos blos rje btsun ma la bdag 'bul na// bzhes nas bla (266)med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ /sngags mthar/ rū pa shab+da gan+dhe ra sa spar+she pra tī ts+tsha swā hā// zhing 'dir rin chen sna bdun gyis// mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang ste// dngos grub 'dod pa sbyin pa'i phyir// nyin re shes rab can gyis 'bul/ sap+ta ma hā rat+na/ nang mchod byin brlabs la thigs gtor 'bul zhing*/ oṃ gsum ma la 'bru gsum btags pa dang*/ /rgyal ba kun yum rje btsun mkha' spyod ma// rigs lnga mkha' 'gro'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// rdo rje 'chang sogs nam mkha'i dbyings gang ba'i// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// 'khor lo sdom pa la sogs yi dam lha// bar snang khyab pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// ma mgon lcam dral dam can chos skyong ba// sa gzhi khyab pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// skye bzhi lam rgyud lngas bsdus sems can kun// rnal 'byor mar gsal zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsi myang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swā bhā ba ād+ma ko3haṃ// 'dir ni thog ma dbus mtha' med// srid med mya ngan 'das pa med// bdag med gzhan yang med pa ste// 'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid/

/ces pa'i don la mnyam bar bzhag pa rnams kyis mchod/ mchod phreng rgyas par spro na rigs mthun gzhan nas blang bar byas/ /de nas bstod pa rkang brgyad ni/ rol mo dang cang te'u'i sgrar sbyar bas// oṃ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo 'phags ma ni// gzhan gyis mi thub 'jig rten gsum yum rig ma ste// dbang phyug 'byung po'i 'jigs pa kun sel rdo rje che// rdo rje'i gdan ma mi pham dbang mdzad gzhan mi rgyal// spyan 'phrul dug skem drag mo khro mo mche gtsigs ma// skrag byed gsod byed 'joms byed rnam rgyal gzhan las rgyal// rmugs byed rmongs byed rengs byed rdo rje phag mo ni// rnal 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang mo mkha' 'gror 'dud// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ (267) sogs sh+lo ka gcig /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'chings gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ lte ba'i dbus gnas 'byung bzhi 'phro// chos dang longs spyod rdzogs par ldan// mkha' 'gro ma rnams sdud mdzad ma// rje btsun ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes pa tsam mam/ nus shing spro na jo bo rjes mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod dkar mo'i bstod pa sogs gnyis/ dmar mo'i bstod pa gzhan dag nas 'byung ba ci rigs pas bstod/ slar yang*/

rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i yum gyur bcom ldan ma// chos dbyings shes rab pha rol phyin ma'i dngos// zag med bde stong lhan cig skyes ma'i sku// rdo rje btsun mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul// nyes byas thams cad snying nas so sor bshags// yi rang chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// rtag tu bzhugs gsol dge ba byang chub bsngo// ji srid byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// bla med theg par bdag gis sems bskyed do// dbang bzhi mnos shing dam tshig lam la gnas// byin rlabs rgyud sbyangs rim pa gnyis la sgom// ngo mtshar spyod pa gsum gyis rol ba sogs// mtha' dag lam rnams bdag gis bsten par bgyi// ting 'dzin brtan cing phrin las thogs med 'grub// pho nya gsum 'dus grub pa brgyad sogs thob// 'gro ba'i don spyod mthu dang ldan pa yi// tshe 'dir he ru ka dpal thob par shog ces bstod/ skabs 'dir gtor 'bul gong du smos pa ltar byin brlabs/ rje btsun ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i sogs nas/ mchod bstod brin las bcol bar bya/ de nas tshogs kyi mchod pa ni/ bde mchog lha lnga'i tshogs mchod phrin las yar 'phel ltar la/ (268) byin rlabs bebs pa'i thog mar/ oṃ mi g.yo 'og min nyams dga'i zhing*// dag pa bde stong mkha' spyod na// shes rab pha rol phyin ma la// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhes grags// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor// khyed kyi rjes su bdag slob kyis// byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol/ /zhes sbyar/ 'di nyid mdor bsdus pa'i dbang gis/ 'dir rnams chos rnams sogs brda dang brda'i 'bul len ma byas kyang rung*// lhag ma byin gyis brlab/ oṃ kha kha sogs dman lhag kho nas 'thus/ rjes mchod pa kha gsos la byin brlab/ sngags tsam gyis phyi mchod dang*/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pa'i nang mchod bul/

rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal ba dang dag pa mkha' spyod kyi gnas su 'khrid par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes sogs 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ sngags dman pa dang cho ga dman// bya ba dman pa gang gyur pa// thabs dang mchog gi bdag nyid gtso// lha mo de dag bzo mdzad rigs// lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te// bden pa de yis lha mo de dag gis// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces sogs smon lam bya zhing rten yod na mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa rnams brtan bzhugs bya/ dam tshig pa rang gi spyi bo nas zhu ste thim pa sogs bdag bskyed ltar bya zhing dge ba bsngo// rten med na dam ye gnyis ka rang la bstim/ mgron thabs kyi lha rnams sarba gats+tshas rang gnas su gshegs/ bkra shis bka' rgya ma'am zhal nas gsungs pa'i tshig phreng ci rigs brjod pas bde legs su bya'o// shangs chos rtsa ba gser chos lnga'i ya gyal me tog mkha' spyod dkar dmar zhes yongs su grags kyang*// byin rlabs kyi bka' gsum dang yig rnying kha shas zhig gi lung rgyun 'pho ba'i khrid srol tsam las yig cha phal (269)cher gyi rgyun ma bzhugs pa dang*/ skabs 'dir ni grub mchog gong ma dag gis mdzad pa'i yig cha ci rigs bzhugs par nges pa'ang bka' lung lta ci smos/ dpe tsam yang spyad yul du ma gyur bas/ zab chos 'di nyid nyams len gyi rgyun nub par phongs te/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung rab rtsa bar bzung*/ yig rnying gi dgongs bcud bsdus/ rigs mthun 'os shing 'thad pas zur brgyan nas 'dus gsal du bkod pa'o// chos 'dir dad cing gzhan la phan 'dod blos// 'os par bsam zhing 'thad par sbyar rloms kyang*// don zab gnas la byis blo rnam par 'khyams// de bas 'gal 'khrul bla ma lha la bshags// 'gro kun rdo rje btsun mos rjes bzung ste// mkha' spyod thar pa'i pho brang nyams dga' bar// tshogs kyi dbang phyug snying rje'i stobs can tu// gyur nas mkha' khyab 'gro kun 'dren byed shog

/ces pa'ang zab chos 'di la mi phyed pa'i 'dun pa can karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos dpal spungs yang khrod de bī ko ṭi tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub gnas su dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen la rdzogs par sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/// / (270)
